title: Attackers mine Monero on live N-central servers hours after exploit release Huntback reports that a newly published N-central exploit instal
content_md:
Attackers mine Monero on live N-central servers hours after exploit release Huntback reports that a newly published N-central exploit instal

via Mastodon https://secquill.com/articles/attackers-mine-monero-on-live-n-central-servers-hours-after-exploit-release/

CVE-2026-90436.evidence: Huntback (relayed by SecQuill, article read in full) reports the 4EverAble2Shell exploit installed Monero miners on 21 live MSP N-central servers within hours of publication, 19 of which had applied 2026.4 Hotfix 2.
